title: Emperor Ssraeshza and the Blood
summary: Defeat the Blood to awaken the Emperor, then control his linked royal guards.
overview: Defeat the Blood to awaken the Emperor, then control his linked royal guards.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Keep the guard team organized through the delay between the Blood and the Emperor.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: The Blood creates a protected Emperor and shares aggro with eight guards.
Killing the Blood starts a randomized three-to-five-minute Emperor activation delay.
The active Emperor re-engages any idle guards every 30 seconds.
A one-hour reset timer restores the Emperor's protected state.

notes: Approval E310. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
This entry is for the open-world version 0; the boss explicitly depops from nonseasonal instances.
